description: Domain-oriented microservices behind Azure API Management with AKS workload hosting, mutual TLS between services, centralized JWT validation at the gateway, and private ingress from a hub-spoke virtual network.
constraints: No direct public access to individual microservices
Centralized rate limiting and WAF at the gateway
Service-to-service auth via managed identity or mTLS
requiredCapabilities: Azure Application Gateway or Front Door
assumptions: Eight to twelve microservices at GA
Gateway handles north-south traffic only; east-west stays inside the cluster mesh
